title: Backend: Service + Repository + API
description: Wire the backend stack: create Repository (strategy_backtest_repo.py) for DB persistence, Service (strategy_backtest_service.py) to orchestrate data fetch -> indicators -> engine -> persist, API schemas (api/v1/schemas/strategy_backtest.py) and endpoints (api/v1/endpoints/strategy_backtest.py) with POST /run, GET /history, GET /{run_id}. Register router in api/v1/router.py.

criteria: POST /api/v1/strategy-backtest/run accepts StrategyBacktestRequest, runs backtest, persists results, returns StrategyBacktestRunResponse
GET /api/v1/strategy-backtest/{run_id} returns full run detail with trades and equity curve
strategy_backtest_repo.py implements: save_run(), get_run(), get_history(), save_trades(), save_equity()
strategy_backtest_service.py implements: run_backtest() orchestrating data fetch -> indicator calc -> engine run -> persist
Service uses DataFetcherManager for historical data access (existing pattern)
Router registered in api/v1/router.py under /api/v1/strategy-backtest prefix
API schemas in api/v1/schemas/strategy_backtest.py follow existing backtest.py schema patterns
convergence.definition_of_done: All 3 API endpoints functional and returning correct JSON responses

Create service orchestrating: fetch data via DataFetcherManager -> calc indicators -> run engine -> persist results, following backtest_service.py pattern
Create FastAPI Pydantic schemas for request/response models following existing backtest.py patterns
Create FastAPI router with POST /run, GET /history, GET /{run_id} endpoints following existing endpoint patterns
Register strategy_backtest router with /api/v1/strategy-backtest prefix, following existing router registration pattern
